help.c.blinded.d: Fails checks requiring sight. Attacks against it: advantage. Its attacks: disadvantage.
help.c.charmed.d: Can't attack the charmer, who has advantage on social interactions with it.
help.c.frightened.d: Disadvantage on checks/attacks while it sees the source. Can't willingly move closer to it.
help.c.restrained.d: Speed 0. Attacks against it: advantage. Its attacks: disadvantage. Disadvantage on Dex saves.
help.c.poisoned.d: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
help.c.prone.d: Moves by crawling. Its attacks: disadvantage. Attacks against it: advantage in melee, disadvantage at range.
help.c.incapacitated.d: Can take no actions or reactions.
help.c.stunned.d: Incapacitated, faltering. Fails Str and Dex saves. Attacks against it: advantage.
help.c.paralyzed.d: Incapacitated, can't move. Fails Str/Dex saves. Attacks against it: advantage. Hit in melee = critical.
help.c.petrified.d: Turned to solid substance. Incapacitated, resistance to all damage, immune to poison/disease.
help.c.unconscious.d: Incapacitated, falls prone, drops what it holds. Fails Str/Dex saves. Attacks: advantage. Melee = critical.
help.c.invisible.d: Can't be seen. Its attacks: advantage. Attacks against it: disadvantage.
help.c.exhaustion.d: 1: disadvantage on checks · 2: speed halved · 3: disadvantage attacks & saves · 4: max HP halved · 5: speed 0 · 6: death.
help.a.attack.d: One melee or ranged attack (more with Extra Attack).
help.a.cast.d: Depends on the casting time (often 1 action).
help.a.dash.d: Extra movement equal to your speed.
help.a.disengage.d: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.
help.a.dodge.d: Attacks against you: disadvantage; advantage on your Dex saves.
help.a.help.d: Give an ally advantage (attack or check) or help in combat.
help.a.ready.d: Pick a trigger + an action/movement performed as a reaction.
help.a.useobj.d: Interact with an object that requires an action.
help.a.bonus.d: Bonus: only if a feature allows it. Reaction: 1 per round (e.g. opportunity attack).
help.r.short.d: Spend Hit Dice (1dN + CON mod) to heal; some features recharge.
help.r.long.d: Full HP; recover half your Hit Dice (min 1); spell slots restored.
help.u.adv.d: Roll 2d20, keep the higher / lower. They don't stack (only one applies).
help.u.cover.d: +2 AC (half), +5 AC (three-quarters), total = no line of effect.
help.u.surprise.d: A surprised creature can't act or react on its first turn.
help.u.death.d: At 0 HP: 1d20. ≥10 success, <10 failure. 3 successes = stable, 3 failures = dead. 1 = 2 failures, 20 = +1 HP.
help.u.massive.d: If damage ≥ your remaining max HP drops you to 0, you die instantly.
